beat: Dhika's surprised response, Bantu apologizes, Bobby quietly voices desire to taste milk
translationStatus: complete working local draft / author review pending

lines.original: She wasn't angry.... but very surprised.....
lines.local: Woh gusse se zyada achaanak hui baat par hairaan thi; bilkul gussa nahi thi, aisa bhi seedha nahi kaha ja sakta.

lines.original: Bantu: still finger in his mouth...Mi...ss... he just blinked like a child caught with cookie jar....
lines.local: Bantu ab bhi ungli munh mein rakhe: Mi...ss... cookie churaate pakde gaye bachche ki tarah bas palkein jhapkaata raha.

lines.original: Dhika: how dare you............. she laughed with playful anger + littttlle real anger......... and took the pillow and started hitting him wildly..
lines.local: Dhika: How dare you! Usne playful gussa aur thoda asli gussa milaakar hansi; pillow uthakar use zor-zor se maarne lagi.

lines.original: Bantu was so glad that she wasn't angry over his crazy act.. and quickly remembered that she has promised she won't ever get angry on them.
lines.local: Bantu ko rahat thi ki woh uske sudden act par bahut gussa nahi hui. Use jaldi yaad aaya ki pehle usne promise kiya tha ki twins par kabhi gussa nahi hogi.

lines.original: Dhika did not get angry for an entirely different reason.. she remembered that no one forced her... she only removed her T shirt by herself....
lines.local: Dhika ke kam gussa hone ki wajah alag thi: use yaad tha kisi ne zabardasti T-shirt nahi utaarwaayi; usne khud utaari thi. Lekin yeh Bantu ke bina poochhe breast touch ki permission nahi thi.

lines.original: Dhika: that was so bad Bantu....go..... I gave you so much space.... she pouted her lips
lines.local: Dhika: Bantu, yeh bahut galat tha! Jaao! Maine tumhe kitni space de di... Usne hont phula liye.

lines.original: Bantu: miss... please... sorry........ I gave into temptation... sorry sorry....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss please, sorry... temptation mein aa gaya. Sorry, sorry!

lines.original: Bantu: naughty fellow... go away... she smiled open mouth and pushed him with the pillow... All the while crossing one arm against her boobs...
lines.local: Source mein speaker 'Bantu' likha hai, lekin dialogue Dhika ki taraf se lagta hai: 'Naughty fellow, jaao!' Woh muskurakar pillow se Bantu ko dhakka deti hai; ek baah breasts cover kiye rakhti hai. Speaker attribution author review mein confirm karna hai.

lines.original: Bobby was still sitting on the floor quietly and looking between both of them.
lines.local: Bobby ab bhi farsh par chup baitha tha, dono ki taraf dekh raha tha.

lines.original: Dhika: SIR...she barked playfully at him... Say something... Always sitting and blinking quietly.....
lines.local: Dhika ne mazaak mein garajkar kaha: SIR! Kuch toh bolo! Hamesha chup baithkar palkein jhapkaate rehte ho!

lines.original: hehe....but she did not expect what he did in return...
lines.local: Hehe... lekin Bobby ne jawab mein jo kiya, uski Dhika ko ummeed nahi thi.

lines.original: Very calmly...... he stood up, shirtless... bulge a little down.. moved and sat on the sofa.....and said...
lines.local: Woh bahut calmly utha, shirtless tha aur bulge kuch kam ho chuka tha; aakar sofa par baitha aur bola...

lines.original: Bobby: with innocent eyes.... I couldn't taste the milk....
lines.local: Bobby seedhi, innocent nazar se: Main milk taste nahi kar paaya.
